pages.text: Start here. Everything else is placed relative to the core.$(br2)Leave at least $(num)2 blocks$() of space under it and clear about $(num)37 x 37$() blocks around it.

When the full structure is in place, the core switches to a brighter glow. That means the reactor is $(good)formed$().$(br2)It re-checks the structure every 2 seconds, so breaking a block un-forms it.
pages.title: Formed
